claude_proposed_widenings.name: stored_spell_reservoir_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Reserve variant needs persistent item-owned spell storage with bounded capacity measured in spell levels, intake from arbitrary outside casters at cast time, and later release using the original caster's slot level, DC, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability. No existing magic-item family or effect atom can honestly carry dynamic stored spells plus preserved casting parameters.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "The stone can store up to 4 levels of spells at a time... Any creature can cast a spell of level 1 through 4 into the stone by touching it as the spell is cast... While this stone orbits your head, you can cast any spell stored in it. The spell uses the slot level, spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original caster"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: reaction_resource_cost_equals_triggering_spell_level
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Absorption and Greater Absorption variants do fit the triggered-reaction family conceptually, but their lifetime burnout meter advances by the triggering spell's level, not by a fixed 1-use cost or a charge-cast schedule. The current activation-resource surface has no honest way to consume variable resource amount derived from the triggering spell.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can take a Reaction to cancel a spell of level 4 or lower... Once the stone has canceled 20 levels of spells, it burns out"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: orbiting_item_state
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: All Ioun Stones share an activated orbiting state with its own start/stop flow and concurrent cap. Passive `wearing_item` can model "while orbiting" benefits, but it does not model the Magic action to begin orbiting, the Utilize action to seize and stow orbiting stones, or the global limit of three stones orbiting at once.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "When you take a Magic action to toss an Ioun Stone into the air, the stone orbits your head... You can have up to three Ioun Stones orbiting your head at the same time... As a Utilize action, you can seize and stow any number of Ioun Stones orbiting your head"
